schema_note: Provenance pointer manifest. Points to authoritative sources rather than embedding them. Revise the git_commit and any changed paths whenever this is regenerated.

code_provenance.note: Update git_commit when regenerating this manifest.

input_data.note: All rasters co-registered to a common extent, CRS, and resolution.

primary_rasters.role: baseline abiotic condition anomaly (signed float; negative = degraded)
baseline biotic condition anomaly (signed float; negative = degraded)
eligible-pixel mask (target LULC intersected with valid objective values)

derived_layers.note: Computed in-memory by data_loader.py at load time, NOT read as primary inputs. The data/landscape_context.tif and data/restoration_potential.tif files exist but are legacy/unused for the default path.
derived_layers.restoration_potential: mean of abiotic + biotic baseline anomaly per eligible pixel
derived_layers.landscape_context: hybrid 0.75*sn_dens[300 m] + 0.25*good-neighbour-fraction[500 m]; higher = more supportive (redefined 2026-06-24)
derived_layers.connectivity_gain: per-pixel focal-habitat gain, circular kernel radius ~100 m

scenario_rasters.role: condition-anomaly scenarios: global vs upper_q75 benchmark, and leave-one-out indicator variants

superseded.note: superseded by implementation_cost_corrected.tif (zero-cost grassland bug fixed 2026-04-16)

run_provenance.note: Append-only log of runs. Per-run reports and pkl outputs are written to the outputs/ tree.

key_parameters_snapshot.note: Values from Core_optimisation/ run scripts (run_custom.py, run_planning_unit_optimization.py). See artifacts/assumptions.md for rationale and confidence.
key_parameters_snapshot.budget_tolerance: +/-5% (patch, pixel_tolerance=0.05); evaluated at +/-7.5%; planning-unit runs use 0.20
key_parameters_snapshot.anomaly_weight_scale_sigma: 1.0 in restoration_effect(), 0.5 in build_repair_scores() (code paths disagree; no run script sets the key)
